stock.description: Genesis Scale Holdings Ltd. functions primarily as an investment holding entity. The company is actively involved in the development, manufacturing, and supply of innovative products designed for future technology sectors, in addition to offering a variety of advanced technological service solutions. Its principal operational territories include mainland China and Hong Kong. The firm, established in January 1992, has its corporate headquarters located in Hong Kong.
